title: Improving the accuracy of the Lorentz Integral Transform method using complex kernels
summary: The Lorentz integral transform (LIT) method is a powerful tool for calculating quantum response functions; however, it requires an ill-posed inversion. Here we show that solutions of the LIT equation can also determine two additional integral transforms: a complex Stieltjes transform and a double-pole transform, at little additional computational cost. A Fourier analysis of the associated deconvolution problem shows that both alternative kernels are better conditioned than the Lorentzian kernel at the same width parameter $Γ$.
